Ranking for you: #1 SPY (9.4/10); #2 YIELD (7.8/10); #3 BND (7.3/10). Best fit: SPY.

Its high score reflects its strong historical performance, liquidity, and cost-effectiveness, making it an attractive option for investors seeking growth through equity exposure.
